en.title: Full Stack Developer
en.stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, AWS

details.heading: Full Stack Developer
items: Led the development of five major projects, three of them for sharing information and ideas, with Node.js/NestJS and PHP/Laravel on the back end, REST and GraphQL APIs, and React/Next.js and Blade on the front end.
Led the discussion, analysis and development of new projects, checking their technical feasibility and their fit with business goals.
Worked with the Product team on portfolio management, analysis and risk requirements, and implemented and updated application modules under its supervision.
Worked with PHP (CodeIgniter and Laravel), GraphQL and REST APIs, React and Next.js, Node.js and NestJS, Python, MySQL and PostgreSQL, Jira, Jenkins and AWS (RDS, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS and Lambda).

details.heading: Backend Developer
items: Built web applications with Node.js, TypeScript and Next.js, connecting front end and back end through GraphQL and REST APIs.
Built serverless architectures with AWS Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch and S3.
Managed PostgreSQL and Redis databases.
Turned business requirements into features with designers and other developers, from planning to delivery and maintenance, using GitLab and Jira.

details.heading: Frontend Developer
items: Built responsive interfaces with React, Material UI and Bootstrap, with state management in Redux.
Wrote JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS, integrated libraries such as jQuery and improved front-end performance.
Took part in code reviews and unit testing.

pt.title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack

details.heading: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
items: Liderei o desenvolvimento de cinco grandes projetos, três deles de compartilhamento de informações e ideias, com Node.js/NestJS e PHP/Laravel no back-end, APIs REST e GraphQL, e React/Next.js e Blade no front-end.
Liderei a discussão, a análise e o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, verificando a viabilidade técnica e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
Trabalhei com o time de Produto nos requisitos de gestão de carteira, análise e risco, e implementei e atualizei módulos das aplicações sob sua supervisão.
Trabalhei com PHP (CodeIgniter e Laravel), GraphQL e APIs REST, React e Next.js, Node.js e NestJS, Python, MySQL e PostgreSQL, Jira, Jenkins e AWS (RDS, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS e Lambda).

details.heading: Desenvolvedor Backend
items: Desenvolvi aplicações web com Node.js, TypeScript e Next.js, ligando front-end e back-end por GraphQL e APIs REST.
Construí arquiteturas serverless com AWS Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch e S3.
Gerenciei bancos de dados PostgreSQL e Redis.
Transformei requisitos de negócio em funcionalidades com designers e outros desenvolvedores, do planejamento à entrega e à manutenção, usando GitLab e Jira.

details.heading: Desenvolvedor Frontend
items: Desenvolvi interfaces responsivas com React, Material UI e Bootstrap, com o estado da aplicação em Redux.
Escrevi JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS, integrei bibliotecas como jQuery e melhorei o desempenho do front-end.
Participei de revisões de código e de testes unitários.
